Title: Microsoft Cognitive Services | Language Understanding speech to intent

Body.Content:
Language Understanding (LUIS), a machine learning-based service, offers simple tools to build your own language understanding models (intents/entities) to help any bot or app provide natural language-based user interactions. LUIS now integrates speech to intent, which combines speech-to-text and text-to-intent capabilities.

Learn More
